info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description:
The course is to introduce the student to the field of marketing research which serves a central basis for marketing decision making. This course covers the basic concepts in measurement, research design, data collection, data analysis and presentation of findings.

AI supports idea suggestion by providing comprehensive information about the fields and topics that students are interested in for research assignments in the field of marketing.
info.studentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (www.flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

assessments.knowledgeSkill:
4 Milestones of the project

1 member of the group will be assigned to present each milestone. There might be two students if the group has more than 4 members.
assessments.note:
Each member of the group will be assign to present with 1 specific part of the 4 milestones.

The purpose of the milestone presentations is to check the progress of the project.

Based on the content of the milestone presentation, feedback will be given to the whole group on the project so that they can improve their performance in the final presentation

The assessment will be conducted individually and individual marks are given to the presenters base on the students' performance during their presentation and their overall understanding, contribution of the group project

assessments.gradingGuide:
Group presentation in class room

and Final report submitted on the last slot
assessments.note:
The presentation (15%) will be evaluated either by the business and the Lecturer. The mark is given based on both the depth and width of the goal achievement of the research project, the feasibility of the recommendations and the presentation skills. The language of this presentation might be either in Vietnamese or in English as it is easier for the industry to evaluate.

The written report (10%) is marked by the instructor based on the research project, the feasibility of the recommendations and the overall presentation of the report . A copy of this written report will be sent to the business also. The language for this report must be in English
